risk_summary: The disclosure is highly quantified and specific but indicates substantial leverage, refinancing dependence, and restrictive credit-facility terms. Liquidity is projected to cover obligations only through 2012, while the company expressly provides no assurance regarding repayment or refinancing. Regulatory findings concerning the Macau relationship and the mandated Borgata divestiture add material legal and asset-realization risk.
